question: Who among the following got elected as the Head of the State for four times? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (16/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Viktor Zubkov
Boris Yeltsin
Vladimir Putin
Dmitry Medvedev
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Vladimir Putin

Explanation:
Vladimir Putin has been elected as the President (Head of State) of Russia four times. He was first elected in 2000, re-elected in 2004, again in 2012, and for the fourth time in 2018. Boris Yeltsin served as President only twice (1991 and 1996). Dmitry Medvedev served as President once (2008–2012), and Viktor Zubkov served as Prime Minister, not President. In Russia, the presidential term is 6 years, and a person can serve a maximum of two consecutive terms; however, Putin won four elections with an interval (2008–2012 when Medvedev was President).

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन चार बार राज्य के प्रमुख के रूप में निर्वाचित हुआ? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (16/01/2021) Shift 2)

Explanation:

question: Which was the first vehicle to soft-land safely on the surface of the Moon? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (16/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Apollo 17
Sputnik 25
Luna 9
Ranger 6
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Luna 9

Explanation:
The first vehicle to safely soft-land on the Moon's surface was the Soviet Union's Luna 9. It landed on February 3, 1966, and transmitted the first photographic images from the lunar surface to Earth. Prior to this, Luna 2 (1959) had crash-landed on the Moon. Apollo 17 (1972) was a crewed mission, while Sputnik 25 (1963) and Ranger 6 (1964) failed. Luna 9's success marked a milestone in lunar exploration, paving the way for subsequent Soviet Luna series and the American Surveyor program.

☛ India's Moon soft-landing mission → Chandrayaan-3 (2023)

question: Who among following is NOT related with Indian Space Program? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (16/01/2021) Shift 2)

solution:

Explanation:

question: Kuna is the currency of which one of the following countries? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (18/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: Kenya
Croatia
United Arab Emirates
Sudan
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Croatia

Explanation:
Kuna (HRK) was the official currency of Croatia from 1994 until 2023, when it was replaced by the Euro. The word "kuna" means "marten" in Croatian, referencing the historical use of marten pelts as currency. Among the options, Kenya uses the Kenyan shilling, United Arab Emirates uses the dirham, and Sudan uses the Sudanese pound. Croatia adopted the Euro on January 1, 2023, making the Kuna obsolete. The currency was subdivided into 100 lipa.

question: The International Criminal Police Commission (ICPC), predecessor to INTERPOL was founded at _____ in 1923. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (20/01/2021) Shift 2)

question: In which year was the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD), better known as the World Bank, established to help Europe recover from the devastation of World War II?  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/01/2021) Shift 1)
